Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.a1: Yes — you get {limit} free generations with no signup required. Pro unlocks unlimited use for €9/month.
Faq.q2: Why three different versions instead of one description?
Faq.a2: Airbnb guests read stories, Booking.com guests scan facts, and Instagram needs a short caption. HostCopy AI writes each one for how that platform's guests actually read.
Faq.q3: What does the Premium plan add?
Faq.a3: Premium adds an AI property walkthrough — upload photos or a link and it drafts a room-by-room tour — plus bulk generation for managing multiple listings at once.
Faq.q4: Do you store my listing information?
Faq.a4: No — your inputs are only used to generate the description and are not saved or shared.
